resolution.zhHans: 犯人是 Sumito Ashizawa。他用蜡烛做了一种摇臂装置，以便在 Urushibara 睡着、而他离开帐篷时稍后点燃帐篷。因此他诱导其他人相信蜡烛的移动实际上是 Urushibara 在帐篷里做深蹲所致，暗示他还活着，并且只有 Danno 才可能是凶手，因为深蹲之后他来到了帐篷。Ashizawa 让受害者保持坐姿，用他自己的胶带把双手绑在脑后，以防止他在燃烧的帐篷将他弄醒时逃脱。这意味着警方将在没有烧毁的石膏上发现 Ashizawa 的头发和指纹，以及 DNA 和皮肤碎屑。别忘了他用来从内部锁住帐篷后逃生的美工刀，刀刃上大概沾有帆布纤维。地点：篮球场
resolution.en: The culprit is Sumito Ashizawa. He made a kind of rocker arm with candles to set fire to the tent later on, Urushibara being asleep and him being away from the tent. He therefore lured the others into believing the candles' movement was actually due to Urushibara doing squats in the tent, implying he was alive and that only Danno could have been the murderer, as he came to the tent after the squats. Ashizawa had put the victim in a sitting position and stuck his hands together behind his head with his own plasters to prevent him from escaping when the burning tent would wake him up. Which means the police will find Ashizawa's hair and fingerprints, along with DNA and skin particles, on the plaster which didn't burn. Not forgetting the cutter he used to escape the tent after locking it from the inside, which has probably some canvas fibers on his blade. Location: Basketball court
